eyebrow.zh: 批准前 · 看代价 · 不动机器
eyebrow.en: Before approve · See the cost · Nothing runs

headline.zh:
批准前，先看清
这份计划要花多少
headline.en:
See what a plan costs
before you approve it

sub.zh: 像数据库的 EXPLAIN——agent 执行前，先给你这份计划的成本与风险预演。
sub.en: Like a database EXPLAIN — a cost & risk preview of the agent's plan, before it runs.

title.en: What each step costs in tokens

body.zh: 批准前就告诉你每一步预计烧多少 token——读你计划旁的真实文件，给范围与置信度，不给拍脑袋的点估计。
body.en: Tells you the token cost of every step before you approve — reads the real files next to your plan, gives a range with confidence, not a guess.

title.zh: 哪一步最危险，提前标出来
title.en: Which steps are riskiest, flagged ahead

body.zh: 哪一步会动你的文件、跑脚本、外发请求——在第一个 action 跑起来前就标好。
body.en: Which steps touch your files, run scripts, or call out — flagged before the first action runs.

body.zh: 只投影，不执行。不烧 token 去预览 token 花销，本地秒出。你说了才算。
body.en: It projects, never executes. Doesn't burn tokens to preview token spend — instant, local. You stay in charge.

headline.en: See through a plan before you approve it

sub.zh: 一条命令，拿到每一步的代价与风险。
sub.en: One command, every step's cost and risk.

tag.zh: MIT · 开源 · 本地运行
